mapper.sql: SELECT b.booking_id, b.user_id, b.schedule_id, u.user_name, s.aircraft_id, s.departure_airport_id, s.arrival_airport_id, s.departure_datetime, s.arrival_datetime, b.status, b.total_price, b.booking_time AS booked_time, pd.passenger_name, ss.seat_name FROM bookings b JOIN users u ON b.user_id = u.user_id JOIN schedules s ON b.schedule_id = s.schedule_id LEFT JOIN passenger_details pd ON b.booking_id = pd.booking_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN schedule_seats ss ON pd.schedule_seat_no = ss.scheduled_seat_no WHERE b.is_deleted = FALSE AND u.is_deleted = FALSE
